sbam-reviewer.use: Reviews the generated diff against the Sub-Skill spec after all gates pass (WG-11). Cheap model, different from the coder.

sbam-repo-scout.use: Scores repo candidates for a Sub-Skill on close calls (WG-11). Cheap model.

sbam-relevance.use: How useful one parsed document is for the project's goal (RelevanceAnswer, #802)

sbam-rubric.use: Promptfoo llm-rubric grading of free-text outputs in the sbam-promptfoo sidecar (E13.6c)

sbam-knowledge.use: Cognee graph extraction and summaries in worker-knowledge (KnowledgeGraph JSON)

sbam-embed.use: Cognee embeddings (1536 dimensions); the fallback is the same model, because another model would change the vector size
